thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: [sev-2] Elevated 5xx + token-gen latency >1.5s on /v1/chat and /v1/generate across eu-central-1. Errors ~18% starting ~11:02 UTC. Paging oncall.
Maya: I'm oncall, responding. Noticed a spike in cache_miss_rate and batching queue length. I'll take lead until handoff.
deploy-bot: deploy event: service=inference-runtime, rev=release-2026-04-02a, by=ci-system, ts=1881234200
Sasha: Confirmed deploy contains quant profile update and a batching tweak (max_batch_time_ms=80 -> 50). Seeing increased p95 for seq_len ~256.
Omar: I'm free to help. Maya, want me to start scaling KV cache now or do you prefer routing changes first?
Maya: Route first — fallback non-quant variant to reduce CPU/GPU kernel slowdowns. Then KV scale.
Maya: Applying temporary routing: model:redwood-3-quant -> model:redwood-3 (100%). Pushing rule.
incident-bot: ROUTE CHANGE queued by Maya at 11:08 UTC
Ben: Ops: spinning up +3 kv-cache replicas in eu cluster. Command:
```
terraform apply -var=replicas=8 -target=module.kv_cache.eu
```
Nina: Support: Affected customers flagged: NimbusCorp (high throughput), HelixLabs (batch jobs). Logged outbound notes, will append to postmortem.
Sasha: Running quick perf flamegraphs. Early signal: quantized GEMM kernel path increased L2 thrash when sequence padding pattern changed. Could be quant table alignment issue.
Maya: After routing change p50/p95 latencies improving. Error rate down to 5% from 18%, still above baseline. Cache hit rate climbing from 40% -> 72%.
Omar: KV replicas coming up. K/V warming with synthetic prefix ramps.
Ben: Warm script (k8s job):
```
kubectl run kv-warm --image=tools/warm:stable -- /bin/warm --concurrency 50 --requests 10000
```
deploy-bot: rollback candidate: release-2026-03-30z (pre-quant-profile)
Maya: Let's not rollback immediately; prefer to 1) keep fallback routing, 2) run perf matrix vs rollback, 3) if quant fix is trivial we patch and roll forward. Thoughts?
Sasha: Agreed. I've captured kernel params and will diff against last-known-good. Early diff shows quant_table_stride changed from 64->56 in the new profile.
Omar: Meanwhile, reduce max_batch_time_ms to 30ms cluster-wide to reduce queue tail. Issuing config update now.
Maya: Update applied. p95 improved further. Error rate down to 1.1% after KV warm and batch change at 11:22.
support-bot: Customer alert sent to NimbusCorp and HelixLabs at 11:25 UTC: "We are aware of elevated errors and have applied traffic routing & cache scaling mitigations. Additional update to follow."
Nina: I'll collect timestamps and sample error traces for customer comms.
Maya: Handoff: my shift ends in 25m. Omar will take over incident lead. Omar, want the handover notes?
Omar: Got it. Handover acknowledged. I'll keep routing fallback for 2h and schedule postmortem.
Sasha: Deep dive notes: quant_table_stride mismatch causes misaligned memory accesses in int8 GEMM kernel, extra copies introduced. Repro script in perf sandbox: https://perf.redwood/internal/1881234567/repro
Sasha: Creating ticket INF-3301: investigate quant_table_stride mismatch, add kernel regression test. Assign to Sasha. Due 2026-04-10.
Ben: Creating INF-3302: KV cache warmup test + alert: cache_miss_rate > 12% -> auto-scale. Assign to Ben. Due 2026-04-07.
Maya: INF-3303: batching defaults audit + CI gate for lowering max_batch_time_ms changes. Assign to Omar. Due 2026-04-09.
Omar: Scheduling postmortem: 2026-04-03 14:00 UTC. Invite: https://meet.redwood.company/room/postmortem-1881234567
Nina: I'll draft customer impact matrix (minutes of elevated errors, endpoints, estimated credit). Will attach to the postmortem doc.
Maya: Incident declared resolved at 11:32 UTC. Duration ~30m. Keeping fallback 2h for safety. Root cause likely regression in quant profile causing kernel slowdown + tighter batching that amplified KV misses.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: sev-2 resolved by oncall Maya at 11:32 UTC. Duration: 30m. Initial summary posted to /docs/incidents/1881234567 (draft).
Omar: Follow-ups (short):
- INF-3301 (Sasha): kernel/quant table fix + unit/perf tests, due 2026-04-10.
- INF-3302 (Ben): KV cache auto-scale + e2e warm test, due 2026-04-07.
- INF-3303 (Omar): batching CI gate + config presets per-customer, due 2026-04-09.
- INF-3304 (Maya+Nina): customer comms final version + SLA impact calc, due 2026-04-05.
Sasha: Will add perf artifacts: flamegraphs, kernel diffs, perf-run logs. Linking to postmortem doc once uploaded.
Nina: Support will prepare follow-up emails and schedule calls with top impacted customers. I'll include timeline and mitigations.
Omar: Thanks all for quick moves. Once action items are in tracker, we'll close loop in one-week check-in. :thumbsup:
Maya: TY team. Good call on routing first — avoided larger rollback impact. Closing oncall handover now. :wave:
